findings.note: Journal Gazette editorial reports that Johnson co-authored Senate Bill 10 (2025), which says proof of identification for voting may not include an ID issued by an education institution, requires voter list maintenance at least twice a year, and requires county offices to verify the status of inactive voters. The Senate passed it 39-11 (his own vote not shown on this page). Source is a newspaper, not the official bill page.
subjects: student ID not accepted as voter ID

findings.note: Ballotpedia lists Johnson among the Senate sponsors of HB 1334 (2023), absentee voting. As introduced it requires absentee ballot applications to ask for a driver's license number, ID card number, or voter registration number plus the last four digits of the Social Security number (only one of the first three for an online application), and bars sending an unrequested absentee application.
subjects: ID number to request an absentee ballot
